summary: Verified YouTube bot-verification/consent fix. Backend endpoints (/api/wp/posts/16163 and /api/videos) return correct video_id + video_kind. Web article page renders iframe with src starting exactly with https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/pNxobWWrWys (no youtube.com/embed). Zero console errors, no references to react-native-youtube-iframe in console. package.json no longer contains react-native-youtube-iframe. Native VideoPlayer.native.tsx correctly imports WebView from react-native-webview (not the removed library), uses youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${videoId} with origin=https://retirementorship.com, sets baseUrl:'https://retirementorship.com' on WebView source, includes all required props (allowsFullscreenVideo, allowsInlineMediaPlayback, mediaPlaybackRequiresUserAction={false}, javaScriptEnabled, domStorageEnabled, thirdPartyCookiesEnabled), and uses a modern iPhone 17.2 Safari user agent. Fix is complete and verified.
critical_code_review_comments: VideoPlayer.native.tsx correctly implements all fix requirements: youtube-nocookie.com embed, trusted baseUrl origin, modern iOS Safari UA, required WebView props.
Only residual references to react-native-youtube-iframe are in explanatory code comments (no imports/usages) — safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: YouTube video consent fix verified end-to-end on web (article/16163 renders correct nocookie iframe) and via static native code review. react-native-youtube-iframe fully removed from package.json.
rca_of_issue: Previous player used react-native-youtube-iframe which loaded YouTube embed with about:blank origin, triggering YouTube's 'verify you're a human' consent interstitial. Fix uses a plain react-native-webview with baseUrl set to a stable trusted origin (retirementorship.com) and youtube-nocookie.com/embed URL (which does not use consent cookies). Verified: web iframe src = https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/pNxobWWrWys?playsinline=1&modestbranding=1&rel=0.
